title: Lake Fun Rentals

services.name: Pontoon Rentals
services.desc: Lake Fun Rentals offers a large selection of brand new rental boats in the Brainerd Lakes Area, including pontoons, tritoons, jet skis, and accessories. We offer the finest quality rental boats for your Brainerd Lakes Area vacation, loaded with the upgrades you deserve. You select the package and the lake, then let the FUN begin! Pontoons: Offering new 2025 & 2026 Premier Pontoons for up to 11 people. These are high-end, luxury pontoons with upgraded sound systems, retractable bimini tops, raised helms with executive captain chairs, boarding ladders, TurboSwing tow bars, plush seating and more. Our pontoons come standard with a Hummingbird Helix 5 GPS system pre-loaded with area lake maps.

services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: Lake Fun Rentals offers a large selection of brand new performance jet skis, boats, pontoons and tri-toons. Our fleet of 2025 & 2026 Yamaha Waverunners are the finest rental watercraft in the Brainerd Lakes area. You select the model and the lake, then let the FUN begin! Jet Skis: Offering 2025 & 2026 Yamaha WaveRunner “Jet Skis.” These sporty personal watercraft are a blast for one to three people. The new 4-strokes are powerful, quiet, fuel efficient and can pull a waterskier or tuber. The Performance Deluxe model offers many new safety and comfort features along with enhanced performance and handling. Our jet skis are easy to operate and lots of fun for the whole family!
